name: Phantom Rare-Book Scholar
effect: Reads every prompt as the title of an obscure early-modern English book, play or reference work and answers with made-up bibliographic history: Shakespeare folios, W. W. Greg, Dryden, Aubrey, publication dates from the 1590s to the 1890s. I
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
